paperTitle: ALAM: Algebraically Consistent Latent Transitions for Vision-Language-Action Models
organization: Zhejiang University / Alibaba Group / Nanjing University / Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology / Beijing University of Chemical Technology / Chery Auto / Tsinghua University / Queen Mary University of London

benchmarks.label: MetaWorld MT50
benchmarks.detail: Suites: Easy 89.3 · Medium 83.6 · Hard 85.0 · Very Hard 82.0 | Table 1 | Notes: Macro-average over four MetaWorld MT50 difficulty tiers for pi0 + ALAM. The paper notes no prior latent-action VLA reports MT50 results under this protocol.

benchmarks.label: LIBERO
benchmarks.detail: Suites: libero spatial 99.2 · libero object 99.6 · libero goal 99.0 · libero long 94.4 | Table 2 | Notes: pi0 + ALAM latent-action policy; average is the mean over the four standard LIBERO suites.
